authorized_openings.scope: One provider-free repository-local dual-host Office foundation covering the existing clinician taskpane, medical scribe capability prerequisites and Reception One companion; candidate nomenclature and an integrated role-scoped Reception One product direction may be recorded, but no public rename, patient surface, provider, data access, microphone capture, backend, command, write, deployment or release is authorised.

notes: Raisa and Clinician One remain candidate names; EMR4 remains the repository and technical identity.
Reception One is one backend-owned reception domain exposed through role-scoped receptionist, doctor and future patient surfaces, including future online booking and Rayleen arrival registration.
A third-party service is not selected as the primary booking or arrival product; any future external integration remains subordinate to typed Reception One contracts.

The candidate Raisa delivery direction is cloud-first practice management as a service; any future on-premises or local-model capability is a subordinate edge and may not create parallel clinical, reception or audit truth.
Word Online localhost remains platform-blocked; provider, protected data, voice, clinical actions, patient clients, production, deployment and release remain closed.

claim_scope: One pure runtime classifies authored desktop, web, mobile and unknown Word host fixtures by capability without invoking any observed capability.

Every generated profile is deeply immutable, distinguishes host readiness from product authority and leaves document, microphone, network, provider, patient, clinical, command and write authority false.
The runtime loads before the existing taskpane in source and published copies, initializes during Office.onReady and preserves the accepted Reception One request and summary seam.
A feature inventory binds the earlier clinician taskpane and scribe paths to the newer Reception One work without reclassifying historical evidence or opening legacy direct-backend paths.
Cloud-first delivery is recorded as architecture direction only, with explicit practice scoping and no cloud resource, tenancy, deployment, billing or production mutation.
A local ordinary-browser rendered check and development build passed, but no authenticated Word Online execution, microphone behavior, document operation, backend or provider path was exercised.

contract_evidence.note: The foundation preserves the inherited view-only companion seam and opens no proposal or command authority.
The host capability layer neither reads nor alters Diary state, event freshness or reconciliation behavior.

decisions.summary: Accept the pure shared Office host profile and exact clinician/reception inventory while retaining all data and action gates.

Record Reception One as one role-scoped reception domain spanning staff, doctors and future online-booking and Rayleen patient surfaces, without granting authority to build or release those future surfaces.

Record cloud-first practice management as a service as the primary delivery direction, while restricting any future local-model or on-premises capability to a subordinate edge with no parallel source of truth.

title: Raisa Candidate Dual-host Foundation
unresolved_gates: Raisa and Clinician One are candidate names only; public naming, artwork, domain, ASIC and trade-mark actions remain separately gated.
Authenticated Word Online remains unproven because the accepted localhost development route is blocked before taskpane execution.
The legacy clinician scribe and direct backend paths are inventoried but not yet migrated behind Access AI or revalidated in desktop and web hosts.
Future online booking, Rayleen arrival registration, patient identity, patient writes and external patient clients remain separately gated.
Cloud tenancy, infrastructure, data residency, deployment, billing, production and any local-model edge remain separately gated.
Provider interpretation, protected or product-derived data, voice capture, clinical action, appointment command, production, deployment and release remain closed.
